title: What's left of the workhouse? Buildings, street names and famine graves across Britain and Ireland
excerpt: There is no open list of Britain and Ireland's workhouses, so I mapped what they left behind in open data: 356 traces, from hospitals and flats to Workhouse Lanes, and 14 of 15 mapped workhouse burial grounds in Ireland.
seo_description: A map of the traces Britain and Ireland's workhouses left in open data: surviving buildings, Workhouse Lanes and famine burial grounds.
header_alt: Title card reading 'What's left of the workhouse?' in black and brick red on cream, beside a map of Britain and Ireland dotted with 329 traces: brick red surviving buildings, ochre sites, dark green burial grounds mostly in Ireland, and slate blue Workhouse Lanes in eastern England.
